# Introduction to public.ctn0094data: De-Identified Data from the CTN-0094 Protocol

These are harmonized/normalized data sets produced as part of the
Clinical Trials Network (CTN) protocol number 0094. The data describe
the experiences of care seeking individuals suffering from opioid use
disorder (OUD). This is a US National Institute of Drug Abuse (NIDA)
funded project; to learn more go to
<https://ctnlibrary.org/protocol/ctn0094/>. The datasets which have data
harmonized are from:

- CTN-0027 (<https://ctnlibrary.org/protocol/ctn0027/>),
- CTN-0030 (<https://ctnlibrary.org/protocol/ctn0030/>), and
- CTN-0051 (<https://ctnlibrary.org/protocol/ctn0051/>).

For lists of data tables and summaries of their contents, please see the
“Harmonization Information” vignette.

## Installation

We are currently submitting this package to CRAN. After it is accepted,
you will be able to install the released version of public.ctn0094data
from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

# Do not run yet
# install.packages("public.ctn0094data")
```

For now, you can use the
[remotes](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=remotes) package to install
this database directly from GitHub with:

``` r

remotes::install_github("CTN-0094/public.ctn0094data")
```

## Citing this Package

We expect the paper corresponding to this package will be published
shortly in PLOS One. The expected citation would be

> Balise RR, Hu MC, Odom GJ, Calderon A, Luo SX, Feaster DJ, and the
> CTN-0094 Team. (*In submission*, expected 2024). “The Harmonization of
> ‘High Stakes’ Clinical Trial Data: Medication Assisted Treatment for
> Opioid Use Disorder.” *PLOS One*.

To find citation information for this package, call the following code:

``` r

citation("public.ctn0094data")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`all_drugs`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/all_drugs.md)
  : All drugs taken
- [`asi`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/asi.md)
  : Did patient use intravenous drugs
- [`demographics`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/demographics.md)
  : Patient demographics
- [`detox`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/detox.md)
  : Start and Stop of Detox
- [`everybody`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/everybody.md)
  : Everybody with any data
- [`fagerstrom`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/fagerstrom.md)
  : Fagerstrom Test for Nicotine Dependence
- [`first_survey`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/first_survey.md)
  : First Survey Date
- [`meta_study_length`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/meta_study_length.md)
  : Metadata About Study Length
- [`meta_substance_groups_uds`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/meta_substance_groups_uds.md)
  : Metadata About UDS Groupings
- [`pain`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/pain.md)
  : Self-Reported Pain
- [`psychiatric`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/psychiatric.md)
  : Psychiatric History
- [`qol`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/qol.md)
  : Quality of Life
- [`randomization`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/randomization.md)
  : Randomization Data
- [`rbs`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/rbs.md)
  : Risk Behavior Survey
- [`rbs_iv`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/rbs_iv.md)
  : Risk Behavior Survey IV drug use information
- [`screening_date`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/screening_date.md)
  : Screening Date Information
- [`sex`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/sex.md)
  : Sexual Activity in Risk Behavior Survey
- [`site_masked`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/site_masked.md)
  : Site Regrouped
- [`tlfb`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/tlfb.md)
  : Timeline Followback (TLFB) Drug Use Information
- [`treatment`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/treatment.md)
  : Amount of Study Drug Per Day
- [`uds`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/uds.md)
  : Urine Drug Screening (UDS) Results
- [`uds_temp`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/uds_temp.md)
  : Urine Drug Screening (UDS) Temperature
- [`visit`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/visit.md)
  : Patient Visit Data
- [`withdrawal`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/withdrawal.md)
  : Patient Withdrawal Symptoms Per Day
- [`withdrawal_pre_post`](https://ctn-0094.github.io/public.ctn0094data/reference/withdrawal_pre_post.md)
  : Patient Withdrawal Symptoms Pre and Post Induction
